lines.text: The order checklist PDF used to print every optional term, even when the answer was No. That made it long, and easy to misread.
Now, each optional item prints only when it applies. Here, the EPCG licence is Yes, but the end-user certificate is No.

lines.text: In the PDF, the EPCG licence appears, and the end-user certificate is simply left out.
